test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters which, when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

_ N M N _ M _ _ N _ M N _ N N
solution:
Given :- _ N M N _ M _ _ N _ M N _ N N

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) MMNNNM → **M** N M N **M** - M **N N **N **N** - M N **M** N N

2) NNMNMM → **N** N M N **N** - M **M N **N **M** - M N **M** N N&
